user.title: Hotel Collection diffuser
user.description: Enter the diffuser's IP address on your network. Give it a fixed (reserved) IP in your router first.

error.cannot_connect: The diffuser did not answer on that address and port.

abort.already_configured: This diffuser is already set up.

set_mode.name: Set schedule mode
set_mode.description: Change one of the diffuser's five schedule modes. Fields you leave out keep their current value.

config_entry_id.name: Diffuser
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one diffuser is set up.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the mode on or off.

end.name: End
end.description: End time, after the start: a mode cannot run past midnight (use 23:59, and another mode from 00:00).

spray_seconds.name: Spray time
spray_seconds.description: Seconds of spraying per cycle, 5-300 (15 or more recommended).

record_refill.name: Record refill
record_refill.description: Start a new calibration baseline: how much oil the bottle held after a refill, and when. Leave the time out for now.

config_entry_id.name: Diffuser
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one diffuser is set up.

level_ml.name: Level after refill
level_ml.description: mL in the bottle right after filling. Given with no time, also sets the diffuser's oil remaining.

refilled_at.name: Refilled at
refilled_at.description: When the refill happened, if not now.

run_hours.name: Spray hours since
run_hours.description: Hours the pump sprayed since the refill. Left out, worked out from the schedule.

init.title: HVAC pause
init.description: Pick the entity that shows the HVAC fan is running (a thermostat, a blower sensor or a switch). The diffuser then sprays only while the fan runs and a mode is scheduled. Leave it empty to turn the HVAC pause off.

data.start_delay: Start delay after the fan starts
